_comment: Hand-maintained pending actions merged into pending-actions.json by build-pending-actions.py. Scraped [data-webmaster] notes live on the pages themselves; put site-wide or cross-page issues here. Delete an entry when resolved and re-run the builder.

entries.title: Navigation label: High Power - High Voltage

notes.text: TODO (2026-07-02, added for David): Rename the navigation label 'High Power/Current Pulsers' to 'High Voltage/Current Pulsers' in the Application Briefs and Technical Notes dropdown group headings. The nav menu is baked into every page, so this is a site-wide change across ~289 pages (only ~7 were updated before we paused; all the rest still read 'High Power/Current Pulsers'). Best done as a scripted repo-wide find-and-replace of '<div class="nav-grp2">High Power/Current Pulsers' -> '<div class="nav-grp2">High Voltage/Current Pulsers' rather than editing 289 pages by hand. Note: the top product menu item and the /dei-home.html page may also still say 'High Power/Current Pulsers' - confirm whether those should change too.

RESOLVED 2026-07-04 (keep until David checks it off): form spam protection is now live in /api/form for all forms: honeypot field, Russian-TLD sender block, Cyrillic-content and .ru-link drop, blocklist, and optional Cloudflare Turnstile (activates when TURNSTILE_SECRET is set in Vercel). Original TODO from 2026-07-02 after a narkolog link-spam submission reached web-regs@ and Nutshell.

entries.title: DEI High Power/Current Pulsers line page

notes.text: SEO sweep 2026-07-08 (verify): the page's previous meta description claimed 300 kV, but the page content says 30 kV max for DC supplies. Confirm the correct top-line voltage for the DEI line; the new meta avoids the number until engineering confirms.

entries.title: Model 645 AWG: datasheet vs AWG index conflict

notes.text: SEO sweep 2026-07-08 (verify): the Model 645 datasheet page says 14-bit, 50 MHz; the AWG product-index card says 16-bit, 20 MHz. One of them is wrong. Reconcile against the current published 645 datasheet PDF and fix whichever page disagrees.

entries.title: Model 745T: resolution differs between datasheet and manual

notes.text: SEO sweep 2026-07-08 (verify): the 745T datasheet page states 1 ps resolution while the user-manual page states about 0.25 ps. Confirm the published spec and align both pages.

SEO sweep 2026-07-08 (verify): the PVX-4150 source PDF shows plus/minus 1,500 V while a listing shows plus/minus 15 kV. Confirm the correct rating with engineering before either figure is used in marketing copy.

SEO sweep 2026-07-08 (verify): the 871 manual page contains conflicting frequency-range statements in different sections. The new meta description avoids a range claim; reconcile the manual content against the current 871 datasheet.

entries.title: Model 675: bit depth differs between manual and datasheet

notes.text: SEO sweep 2026-07-08 (verify): the 675 manual page states 14-bit while the 675 datasheet page states 16-bit. Confirm which is right and align the two pages.

entries.title: Sitemap lists a page that does not exist

notes.text: SEO sweep 2026-07-08: sitemap.xml lists /index-bold.html but that file does not exist on the site (404). Remove the entry from the sitemap, or restore the page if it was meant to ship.

SEO sweep 2026-07-08: article-awg-685-optics-appnote.html and article-awg-685-optics-photonics-lasers.html cover nearly the same content and can split search credit. Consider consolidating into one, or pointing a rel=canonical from the weaker page to the stronger one.

entries.title: Web book loader pages: thin/redirect stubs in the sitemap

notes.text: SEO sweep 2026-07-08: 10 /books/ loader pages are thin stubs (they had no meta description or H1; metas were added in the SEO pass), and /books/scintillation-detectors/ is a pure redirect. Consider 301-ing or noindexing the redirect stub and reviewing whether the loader pages belong in sitemap.xml. Related: 31 sitemap pages are not wired into the on-site search index, mostly these stubs.

entries.title: PVP HV power supply: 'manual' URL serves a datasheet

notes.text: SEO sweep 2026-07-08: this URL is named hv-power-supply-manual but the page content is a datasheet. Rename the file (with a redirect) or swap in the actual manual content so the URL matches what visitors and search engines see.
